evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: 3 cadence-aligned observations precede adoption. The adoption commit first parent is fc43d399fbe304278d3920906b90413db31184b8.

caveat: The evidence is observational and does not establish that workflow adoption caused an outcome change.

evidence.opportunity: A weekly immutable snapshot containing at least one non-test Go source file under pkg/.
filters: Exclude files whose names end in _test.go.
Use the last commit on main at or before windowEnd.
A file is compliant when its physical line count is at most 999.
evidence.collection: Resolve all requested cutoffs from batched main-branch commit history, fetch each selected immutable commit archive once, and derive line counts locally. An empty eligible population is missing; when eligible files exist, zero compliant line mass is a valid zero.

model.architecture: Direct threshold-severity primary with a separate compliant-mass diagnostic.
model.recommendation: Use largest-file health as the operational-value measure and retain compliant line mass only as a non-composite diagnostic because the measures can disagree.

presentation.label: Go file-size health
presentation.betterLabel: Higher means the largest eligible file is closer to or within the 999-line healthy range.

summary.nativeLabel: Largest eligible Go file line count

metrics.name: Largest-file health
metrics.formula: min(1, 999 / largestFileLines) when at least one eligible file exists

metrics.name: Compliant line-mass share
metrics.formula: compliantLines / totalLines when at least one eligible file and positive line mass exist
